weekly.narrative:
**Desk view — W45-2026 (2026-10-31 → 2026-11-06)**

**Market and books.** Tape was mixed: MSCI ACWI ETF -0.0394%, U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF -0.0724%, Jakarta Composite +0.4009%, USD/IDR +3.5688% to 18,103.0 (asof 2026-11-07), USD/HKD +0.0115% to 7.8396. Macro regime is balance_of_payments_pressure, risk appetite CAUTIOUS, next full rebuild 2026-12-05; tilts FAVOR nickel/ID supply-discipline, NEUTRAL thermal coal/oil-import beneficiaries/commodity bloc, AVOID INDO rate-sensitive. For INDO, Jakarta strength did not offset the IDR funding leg: South Book -0.67% vs bench -1.23% (active +0.57pp), NAV 15,181,068,662.4 IDR, gross 14.42%, 3 names, drawdown -1.69%. For GLOBAL, ACWI and bonds were slightly down but North Book +0.07% vs bench -3.14% (active +3.22pp), NAV 1,012,651.28 USD, 100% cash, gross 0.0%, 0 names.

**Own decisions.** Right: PTBA was bought at 2,930 for 240,600 shares, below the 3,000 preopen reference; the staged entry was confirmed at 240,600 @ 3,000, 4.90% NAV, and PTBA-001 was sized 5.0% NAV. Both books beat benchmarks. Wrong/friction: 21 INDO decisions produced only 1 trade; PTBA sizing was declined again on the carry convention and blocked on 2026-11-04 by CONSTRUCT QC CRITICAL (price-source prelude race); AADI was killed for no fillable price with positive EV under V5.4. JPFA was cleared to fill and AKRA was waiting at 1,070, but the only recorded trade was PTBA. ERAA’s review condition still does not hold because Q3 LK is absent; KPI is untestable and no exit ticket was issued. GLOBAL made 0 trades across 3 decisions; NVO remains a price trigger. No memos were recorded in period; no theses resolved in period.

**Next.** Watch USD/IDR after +3.5688% and keep AVOID on INDO rate-sensitive; monitor PTBA against 4,842 target/2,488 kill; resolve ERAA’s missing Q3 LK; fix the PTBA carry/QC price-source race; review NVO trigger and superinvestor cuts in coverage (V net -1, MSFT net +1, MA net +2, TSM net -1, AAPL net -3). Next macro rebuild 2026-12-05.

**Lesson.** Mean p_up is 0.3769 while mean_drift_open is +0.1417 — possible under-confidence — but Brier 0.3556 vs base 0.279 and skill -0.275 say calibration is not proven. Log and resolve probabilities before resizing.

monthly.title: Six South Monthly Report · 2026-10
monthly.narrative:
Tape is as-of 6–7 Nov, not 31 Oct: MSCI ACWI ETF 152.37, -0.0394%; U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF 96.55, -0.0724%; Jakarta Composite 5,050.43, +0.4009%; USD/IDR 18,103.0, +3.5688%; USD/HKD 7.8396, +0.0115%. Regime is balance_of_payments_pressure, risk appetite CAUTIOUS. For South Book, IDR weakness and the AVOID on INDO rate-sensitive names matter more than the JCI print; nickel/ID supply-discipline is FAVOR. South returned +0.5% vs bench -17.04% (active +17.54pp), NAV IDR 15,181,068,662.4, gross 14.42%, drawdown -1.69%, 3 names. North returned +0.33% vs -1.38% (active +1.71pp) with gross 0.0%, 0 names, 0 trades; market beta is not the issue — deployment is.

**Review.** Right: South’s +0.5% against -17.04% and -1.69% drawdown is a strong relative outcome; North’s +0.33% against -1.38% came with zero exposure, so it is not evidence of stock selection. Wrong or unresolved: NVO was sized 2.50% NAV at limit 24.00 while house EV is -18.6%, stance EXIT, and to-entry -38.7% — that conflicts with the house view. AADI was staged at 2.5% NAV waiting 7,000 while the ledger records KILL and expected -33.0%. ERAA was vetoed twice (1,358,700 and 1,237,200), then bought 1,332,800 at 525; at 492 it is 6.3% below the trade and near-kill path is 13.3%. MEDC buys at 1,275 and 1,295 sit above the 1,200 mark. PTBA was deferred because the sizing anchor refuses. No memos were logged (memos_in_period: []), so rationale is limited to decision titles and trades.

**Next.** Reconcile AADI and NVO before any fill; enforce house-EV sign at sizing. Watch USD/IDR 18,103.0 and the 18,003.5 w/w reference, DXY within 0.3% of its 12-Oct high, PTBA’s anchor, JPFA at 1,500 (to-entry -0.3%), AKRA at 1,070 (to-entry -19.6%), and the 2026-12-05 macro rebuild. North should address V (-1 net), MSFT (net +1 but 3 cut), MA (net +2 but 2 cut), TSM (-1), AAPL (-3), and TXN cuts.

**Lesson.** The ledger’s Brier is 0.3556 vs base 0.279 (skill -0.275), while mean_drift_open is +0.1417: the desk’s committed probabilities look systematically under-confident, not merely directionally wrong. Recalibrate probability levels, not just calls.
